documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Financial Results For Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September 2026

analysis.summary: Sportking India Limited reported its Q2 and H1 FY27 financial and operational performance, highlighting strong revenue and profit growth alongside capacity expansion plans. Management announced a greenfield capacity addition of 1.50 lakh spindles in Odisha with an outlay of approximately INR 1000 Crores. The company also progressed on sustainability initiatives by commissioning a 40.3 MW solar power plant and pursued strategic acquisitions for forward integration into fabrics and garments. Sportking India Limited reported a strong start to FY27, driven by better yarn realizations, strong export demand, and disciplined raw material procurement. Management highlighted the successful commercial operation of their solar power projects and progress on the 150,000-spindle greenfield expansion in Odisha.

guidance.claim: The company expects top-line revenue to reach around INR3,000 crores in the current financial year and exceed INR4,000 crores next year.
guidance.quote: So this year, last year, our top line was around INR2,500 crores. So this year, we are expecting somewhere around INR3,000 crores. So that's what 20% up. And next year, with the new plant, we see this going up to around more than INR4,000 crores.

guidance.claim: Management guides for a long-term margin of 15% once the Odisha project becomes operational.
guidance.quote: So we give a long-term guidance of once a new project comes in a guidance of 15%, and we'll stick to that.

guidance.claim: The solar project is expected to deliver annual power cost savings of around INR15 crores.
guidance.quote: It should be around INR15 crores with this solar park, yes.

guidance.claim: Revenue contribution from the proposed acquisitions is expected to be around 8% to 10% from next year.
guidance.quote: But in the short-term, we expect these businesses to start contributing to the tune of 8% to 10% to our top line and anywhere close to the similar kind of EBITDA what we have in our bottom line from next year.

guidance.claim: The company expects revenue contribution from the value-added products and downstream businesses to be around 10% in the next year.
guidance.quote: But in next 1 year, we would say around 10%.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand from all markets remained healthy, with the company expecting supportive domestic demand aided by the festive season and improving consumption trends.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand from all the markets continued to remain healthy, and we are also encouraged by the outlook going into the second quarter. On the domestic front, we expect demand to remain supportive in the coming quarters, aided by the festive season and improving consumption trends.

demand_outlook.claim: The current quarter is expected to be similar to or better than the previous quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: See, again, in this macro environment, we really can't comment too much going forward. But yes, the current quarter looks to be similar or even better than what we have delivered this last quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: Most of the incremental demand for yarn export into India has come from China.
demand_outlook.quote: Chinese market was very subdued for last 4, 5 years. And we have seen an increased demand. So most of the incremental demand, which has come into India for yarn export is from China.

demand_outlook.claim: The spinning sector in Bangladesh is undergoing a crisis, which is helping stimulate more demand out of Bangladesh.
demand_outlook.quote: So Bangladesh is doing fantastically well right now and it continues to do well. And we expect it to do even better going forward with all the crisis we are having there of energy crisis and all these crisis among the spinning mill there.

capex_expansion.claim: The proposed capex programme is expected to take 12-15 months to complete.
capex_expansion.quote: # Proposed capex programme to tak 12-15 months to complete

capex_expansion.claim: The board approved the acquisition of a majority stake in Marvel Dyers and Processors Private Limited and manufacturing facilities of Sobhagia Sales Private Limited.
capex_expansion.quote: The Board has approved the acquisition of a majority stake in Marvel Dyers and Processors Private Limited, along with the acquisition of manufacturing facilities of Sobhagia Sales Private Limited on a slump sale basis and land and building on lease basis, subject to the completion and execution of definitive agreements.

capex_expansion.claim: The solar power projects have successfully commenced commercial operations.
capex_expansion.quote: On the strategic front, I'm pleased to share that our solar power projects have successfully commenced commercial operations.

capex_expansion.claim: The 150,000-spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha is progressing as planned.
capex_expansion.quote: Our 150,000-spindle greenfield expansion project in Odisha is also progressing as planned.

capex_expansion.claim: The first phase of production for the Odisha project is expected to commence in the third quarter of the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: Construction activities is underway and the first phase of production is expected to commence during the third quarter of the current financial year and we intend to finish our whole project within this financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The Odisha project has an announced total capex of approximately INR1,000 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So ma'am, right now, what we have announced is about INR1000 crores, INR975 crores and which will be completed by the end of this financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The Odisha project is expected to start contributing 30% to 40% of the total revenue potential in Q4.
capex_expansion.quote: So right now, we are not considering anything for Q3, but whatever we get will be bonus. But in Q4, we expect almost 30% to 40% of the revenues of the total potential to kick in.

margins_costs.claim: The SPV commissioned a Solar Power Plant expected to save power cost by about 12-15% in the long term.
margins_costs.quote: Commenced commercial operations of power supply on 18th June 2026 and is expected to save power cost by about 12-15% in the long term.

margins_costs.claim: The overall yarn spread for the quarter was INR133 compared to INR107 in the previous quarter.
margins_costs.quote: So the overall spread was INR133 vis-a-vis INR107 last quarter.

margins_costs.claim: The solar power project is expected to reduce annual power costs by approximately 12% to 15%.
margins_costs.quote: The project is expected to reduce our annual power cost by approximately 12% to 15%, while simultaneously increasing the share of renewable energy in our overall power consumption.

margins_costs.claim: The Odisha plant will have margins higher by at least 300 to 400 basis points compared to old plants due to embedded incentives.
margins_costs.quote: So about EBITDA accretion, this plant has many incentives which are embedded. So we expect the margins coming out of that plant to be at least 300 to 400 basis points or even more than what we do in our old plants.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported a gross profit of Rs. 228.0 crores for Q1 FY27, with a gross profit margin of 32.4%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company maintains an order book ranging from 70 to 90 days.
orders_capacity.quote: We have an order book ranging from 70 to 90 days in any year, whether it is this year or even the last year or whichever year because this is our policy we work to manage our risk of having higher inventory.

capital_allocation.claim: The board approved the acquisition of a majority stake in Marvel Dyers and Processors Private Limited.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board has approved the acquisition of a majority stake in Marvel Dyers and Processors Private Limited, along with the acquisition of manufacturing facilities of Sobhagia Sales Private Limited on a slump sale basis and land and building on lease basis, subject to the completion and execution of definitive agreements.

capital_allocation.claim: The special purpose vehicle has commissioned a solar power plant with a capacity of 40.3 MW for a period of 25 years.
capital_allocation.quote: The SPV has commissioned the Solar Power Plant with capacity of 40.3 MW for supply of power to Company`s Bathinda and Ludhiana Unit for period of 25 years.

risks_headwinds.claim: The cotton import duty resumption is currently set for 31st October, and the company is talking to the government to extend it.
risks_headwinds.quote: So right now, this import duty is the resumption is still 31st October. And so we have planned accordingly. And we are talking to the government to extend it.

management_commitments.claim: Management intends to finish the entire Odisha greenfield project within the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: Construction activities is underway and the first phase of production is expected to commence during the third quarter of the current financial year and we intend to finish our whole project within this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to reach about 90% capacity utilization for the whole Odisha plant by the end of March.
management_commitments.quote: And I think by March end, we should be at about 90% capacity utilization for the whole plant.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to share a vision and roadmap for downstream businesses in the next 6 to 8 months.
management_commitments.quote: And I think by next 6 to 8 months, we shall share with you the vision for what we have for our downstream businesses.

management_commitments.claim: The proposed capex programme is projected to take 12-15 months to complete.
management_commitments.quote: Proposed capex programme to tak 12-15 months to complete

management_commitments.claim: Commercial operations of power supply from the solar plant commenced on 18th June 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Commenced commercial operations of power supply on 18th June 2026 and is expected to save power cost by about 12-15% in the long term.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
